fills.narrative: Databricks' June 13 Omnigent runs live agent sessions on managed Modal and Daytona cloud sandboxes, makes them shareable by URL for persistent collaborative review, and enforces cost budgets, permissions and OS-level sandboxing across whichever runtime sits underneath. A vendor-neutral harness brokering persistent, policy-bounded execution on managed sandboxes is exactly the durable-execution surface this expects to become assumed infrastructure.
fills.remaining_gap: Omnigent headlines shareable sandboxed sessions, not restart-survivable long-horizon execution, and is one more OSS project rather than the third generally-available durable mode the marker names.
